title: Coefficients of a coordinate derivative
statement: Let $F$ be a real coefficient family on the subsets of $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $i\in[n]$. The coefficient at $S\subseteq[n]$ of the polynomial formed from the Fourier coefficients of the Boolean-cube derivative of $F$ is $0$ if $i\in S$, and is $F(S\cup\{i\})$ if $i\notin S$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on subsets of $[n]$
replaced: Let $F(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}a_S\prod_{j\in S}x_j$ be a real multilinear polynomial and fix $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The coefficient indexed by $S$ in its coordinate derivative is $0$ if $i\in S$, and $a_{S\cup\{i\}}$ if $i\notin S$.
